# color-v1

The exact color state before the ÓE logo based redesign. The `files` directory
preserves the original paths relative to the repository root, including
`palette.css`, `tailwind.palette.js`, the semantic light/dark tokens, navigation
colors, and the calendar grid background. It also includes the remaining
literal color values found in source files at the time of capture.
TypeScript copies have an added `.txt` suffix so they stay outside the active
typecheck; their contents are unchanged.

To restore `color-v1` later, compare these copies with the current files and
restore their color values. Restore the complete files only when their other
code has not changed since this snapshot.
